notes.title: SFD 3.0 Update
notes.notes: [p]*Warning: Save files from the previous version are not compatible. If you want to continue from the previous version, right-click SFD, select Betas, and switch to the Beta version to play.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]It has been a long time since the last update.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]SFD had stopped receiving updates in favor of Crawl Tactics, but after hearing about an achievement bug, I fixed the bug and added a new mode and UI update. This will likely be the final update for SFD.[/p][p align="start"][/p][olist][*][p align="start"]Custom Mode Added: You can now choose one of the basic mercenaries to start with instead of the Adventurer.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Easy Mode Improvements: In Easy Mode, mercenaries (other than the leader) revive after battle if you win, with some HP restored. Also, the Stalling Punishment no longer occurs in Easy Mode.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Dark Apprentice Mage Added: A low-level dark mage who can advance to Necromancer.[/p][/*][*][p]UI Improvements: The overall UI has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][/*][/olist]
